title: GPOM Second Half A: The Kill Bots
heading: GitPush Origin Master ▲ second half A: the kill bots
about: Cut 3 of the GPOM second half, split in two (Kai, round 2 Q5). Built by scripts/gpom/second-half-video/cut3.py A; notes and plan so far in ../second-half-cut2-notes.json, shots in ../second-half-cut3-shots.md.

beats.name: Maddie on the high street
beats.blurb: One unbroken travelling shot: the camera backs up the ruined high street and Maddie rolls after it, chatting, her radio playing the tune; down on "Oh, hello!", back up on "Mind how you go".

beats.name: Patrol, low and huge
beats.blurb: A kill bot rolls over the lens.

beats.name: Their eyes: the kill-bot HUD
beats.blurb: The kill bot's own view keeps moving down the street; the new HUD (patrol, teal). The meter starts to twitch as the row reaches it through the earth.

beats.name: Ping. Organic signal: lock
beats.blurb: Three pings, ORGANIC SIGNAL - LOCK. No freeze: the view keeps rolling while it listens.

beats.name: The lavatory
beats.blurb: Hard cut to full volume: Sandra, lip-synced.

beats.name: The row, up close
beats.blurb: Sandra and Derek, shot by shot, lip-synced.

beats.name: KILL MODE ENGAGED
beats.blurb: The same HUD on the racing view: patrol, then it flips red. The muffled row keeps the meter moving.

beats.name: One kill bot tears past Maddie
beats.blurb: High over the street: the tank passes close, Maddie jolts, a plume of dust hangs.

beats.name: Whoa: Maddie in the dust
beats.blurb: Close on Maddie in the dust: she leaps clear on all six wheels, lands, settles. A startled beep.

beats.name: The far race
beats.blurb: From the footbridge: the pack races away down the motorway.

beats.name: Maddie calls her boss
beats.blurb: Maddie's hatch, the boss-hotline antenna. The call; the race (still far) under the AI's lines.

beats.name: The close race
beats.blurb: Low in the grass: the pack converges on the bunker door. Maddie over it.

beats.name: The stand-down
beats.blurb: On board one kill bot: red KILL MODE racing at the door, it brakes and flips to green PEACE MODE. The pack turns and files away down the hill. Then the boss, through Maddie.
